hints.title: Palindrome Freedom Condition
hints.text: A string contains no palindromic substrings of length two or three if and only if no two adjacent characters match and no characters at distance two match.

hints.title: Rightmost Increment
hints.text: Scan from right to left to find the earliest index where a character can be strictly incremented within the first k letters.

hints.title: Greedy Suffix Assignment
hints.text: After incrementing at index i, fill every subsequent position from i + 1 to n - 1 with the smallest valid character available.

hints.title: Greedy Increment and Fill Implementation

complexity.notes: Greedy increment from right followed by smallest character placement.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive string iteration checks exponentially many invalid configurations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list for character code manipulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that forbidding palindromes of size 2 and 3 guarantees no palindromes of any length.
